book.name: Timoti
book.title: Lihamba lya ulongohi lya Paulo kwa Timoti

content: Hilongohi mu ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito
Nongelo ayi ndo ya hoto, mundu ywakapala kubhengha kilongohi nkulu ghwa ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bha anhyubhalilite Kilisito, aywo kangupala lihengu lya maha

Hino, kilongohi nkulu ghwa ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bha anhyubhalilite Kilisito kangunoghwa kabheghe mundu ywa nga libhaya, kabheghe nnume ghwa nndala yumu ghweka, kahotole kulitabhala, kabheghe na ng'endelo ya maha na unyakatiho, yingunnogha kabheghe na utekulo na ywakahotola kuhunda,
kakotoke kubhegha nnobhi ebu mundu ywa bhulwa ngati kabheghe ntama nuu, ywakapala uhihimilo, kakotoke kubhegha mundu ywa kupala ngalabha,
kangunoghwa kabheghe mundu ywa kululongoha maha lubhagha lwake, na kubhahunda bhana bhaki bhabheghe na nyitikilo na uhokamo kwa ywombe.
Kiyaha handa mundu kangululongoha maha ng'obhe lubhagha lwake, kahotola bhuli kulongoha ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapang bha anhyubhalilite Kilisito?
Kakotoke kubhegha mundu ywangakamala maha mu kunhyubhalila Kilisito, ngati kakotoke kulidumba, hela bhubho kaaghwila mu toso yila yila ya Nchipila.

Ngati kangunoghwa kabheghe mundu ywakabheghite na lutiko lwa maha kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe mu ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito, ngati kakotoke kubhayilwa na kughweghela mu ntambo ghwa Nchipila.
Atangatila mu ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito

Atangatila nabho mu ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalilite Chapanga yinguanogha bhubho bhabheghe bhandu bha kuhokamilwa, akotoke kubhegha na malagho mabhili mabhili, bhakotoke kubhegha alobhi bha ughimbi ebu bhana tama ya utopelo,
yinguanogha kuyighungila muno na yila mbwepo yiihwimulilitwe ya kunhyubhalila Kilisito kwa ulamulo ghwa maha ghwa nkati ya myoyo yabhe.
Yinguanogha bhahingukihwe huti, na handa pabhabhonekana kukita bhangunogha, ndo bhalekekehwe bhatende lihengo lyabhe lya kutangatila bhandu mu ngwemuko.
Na adala bhabhe nabho yingubhanogha kubhegha na uhokamo, bhakotoke kubhegha na malogho gha kuyukuta, ngati bhabheghe na uyukuto na bhanakuhyubhalika mu mihalo yoha.
Ntangatila mu ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito yingunnogha kabheghe na nndala yumo ghweka, na kahotole kualongoha maha bhana bhake na lubhagha lwake bhubho.

Atangatila bha bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila kilisito bhabhatendite lihengo lyabhe maha, bhakilimokolela lutiko lwa maha, na bhanguhotola kulongela kya nga lyogha ya kya kuhyubhalila kwabhe mu Kilisito Yesu.
Hata panukutyekela lihamba ali kunu panhyubhalila kuhika kwa ghwenga kamu,

peni handa ndakabhalila, lihamba ali lyaakumanyiha kya bhula bhandu yinguakwiliha kutama mu nyumba ya Chapanga yunaubhumi, yene ndo ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Chapanga bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito, bhene ndo ngimiko na kitamiko kya hoto.
Kahone mundu ywakapala kulema kwa kya ukulu ghwa mbwepo ya dini ya twenga,

content.text: kakiyimihwa na Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kukita ghwa hoto,
kakibhonekana na andumitumi ghwa kunani kwa Chapanga.
Kakilandamihwa mu bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi
kakitolwa kughenda kunani na kakikingamwa na ukulu.
